pack.name: India Legal Core
pack.description: Maintained primary-law foundation for common India legal questions: constitutional, contract, criminal, evidence, civil procedure, property, family, consumer, company, arbitration, limitation, data protection, real-estate and domestic-violence law. Current amendments and case law still require source verification where material.
